description: TEST FIXTURE for llm_third_opinion (parallel second-LLM A/B comparison). LLM1 verdicts via PRETOOLHOOK_LLMREVIEW_MOCK, LLM2 verdicts via PRETOOLHOOK_LLMREVIEW_MOCK2 (falls back to MOCK when unset). No network is ever contacted except the discard port (127.0.0.1:9) in the deliberate LLM-down cases.
_comment_fixture: Base pair config (design doc docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-30-llm-third-opinion-design.md section 7.1). LLM1 scope = complex_commands/min 2 (NOT 'all' - level 'all' short-circuits Test-LlmReviewScope in-scope and makes the check_blindspot rescue unreachable; per-case level=/min= attributes of the runner DEFAULT to complex_remote/2, so every in-scope XML case must ALSO set level='complex_commands' min='2' explicitly). global strictness NORMAL so strictness_gated semantics stay out of the way. check_blindspot ships OFF in the file; blindspot cases toggle it via the per-case check_blindspot= attribute.
_comment_log_file_path: Own subdir so fullpipe log-contains assertions (LT3-18/LT3-21) read THIS suite's newest entry, not llm-review's.
_comment_trusted_programs: tool-a/tool-b: the all-trusted R2-skip block (LT3-14). src\Classifier.ps1: the D5 trusted-only disagreement case (LT3-19) - the spec's own headline example.
_comment_system_paths: Required by the stage-2 path-guard (Test-GatedInvocationSafe) - without system_paths the compiled regex matches NOTHING. Windows entries are regex (not escaped by the loader) -> quadruple backslashes in JSON.

llm_second_opinion._comment: base_uri = DISCARD PORT: classify cases are fully mocked; the only real-HTTP case (LT3-22) WANTS a fast connection-refused so LLM1 reads 'down'. LLM1 timeout 30000 is also the clamp ceiling asserted by preflight PF-1 (llm_third_opinion.timeout_ms=60000 -> EffectiveTimeoutMs=30000).

_comment_llm_third_opinion: Comparison partner (spec 2026-09-30-llm-third-opinion-spec.md). LIVE fields here: enabled/base_uri/model/api_key/timeout_ms. Every other key is a COPY-PASTE TEMPLATE and IGNORED at runtime - LLM1's llm_second_opinion values decide scope + prompt/sampling for BOTH models (identical-prompt A/B guarantee). Ignored keys are still VALIDATED (typo => load throws). Effective timeout = min(60000, llm1 30000) = 30000.

llm_third_opinion._comment_ignored: Everything except enabled/base_uri/model/api_key/timeout_ms is IGNORED here (read from llm_second_opinion).

Linux.description: Minimal Linux domain (same shape as the llm-review fixture).
